name: Aluminium Oxide
description: Aluminium oxide (Al₂O₃) by thermal ALD (TMA + H₂O/O₃, 150–250 °C, up to 12-inch). Films show breakdown above 7 MV/cm, ε > 7, n = 1.667 @ 587 nm at 1.1 Å/cycle — the reference conformal dielectric for gate stacks and surface passivation.
description_ko: 열 ALD(TMA + H₂O/O₃, 150–250 °C, 최대 12인치)로 성장하는 산화 알루미늄(Al₂O₃)입니다. 절연파괴전계 7 MV/cm 이상, 유전율 7 이상, 굴절률 1.667 @ 587 nm, 성장률 1.1 Å/cycle — 게이트 유전막·표면 패시베이션의 기준 소재입니다.
filmSpecs: Film-coated by thermal ALD process vacuum < 1.0 × 10⁻2 Torr
band2Specs: Applications : Gate Dielectric, Surface Passivation, Conformal Dielectric Coating
